Package org.apache.juneau.console.views

Class PopoverField

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.views.PopoverField
@BeanType(properties="data,title,render") public class PopoverField extends Object
One labelled value in a CellPopover, bound to a top-level row-data key.

Optional render is restricted to the text-shaped built-ins (date, bool, decimal, datetime, ts-zulu). HTML-shaped renderers are rejected at CellPopover.validate().

Since:
10.0.0
